verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs explicitly describe a no-auth domain availability/pricing check endpoint (porkbun-docs-35), plus a dryRun pre-flight check that includes availability (porkbun-docs-44) and mock/sandbox endpoints for testing without a key (porkbun-docs-19, porkbun-docs-38, porkbun-probe-1). However, no evidence specifies explicit rate limits for this endpoint. Missing for 10: documented rate-limit numbers/throttling policy for the availability/search API, and independent confirmation of real-world call limits.
